abilities.name: Shuriken Toss
abilities.desc: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

abilities.name: Jinada
abilities.desc: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.

abilities.name: Shadow Walk
abilities.desc: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.

notes.note0: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.

abilities.name: Friendly Shadow
abilities.desc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

abilities.name: Big Game Hunter
abilities.desc: Bounty Hunter receives 20% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

abilities.name: Track
abilities.desc: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.

notes.note0: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
notes.note1: Track's effect is only visible to allies.
notes.note2: You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
notes.note3: Bonus gold is reliable gold.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.desc: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.

notes.note0: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
notes.note1: When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.

abilities.shard: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to 375/375/375/375 and throw delay is reduced to  seconds.

abilities.name: Fade Bolt
abilities.desc: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.

abilities.name: Arcane Supremacy
abilities.desc: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.

abilities.name: Spell Steal
abilities.desc: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.

notes.note0: Cannot steal item abilities.
notes.note1: Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
notes.note2: Does not trigger spell reflect.

abilities.shard: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
abilities.scepter: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.

abilities.name: Curiosity
abilities.desc:
Rubick gains 1 stack of Curiosity per level that grants him 1 base damage, 0.3% Buff/Debuff Duration, and 2 AOE Bonus. 

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within 1200 distance of him, he gains 2 Curiosity for 20 seconds.  If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last 3 seconds, he gains 1 Curiosity permanently.

abilities.name: Earth Spike
abilities.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.

notes.note0: The spikes move at 2800 units per second.
notes.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: Hex
abilities.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.

notes.note0: Instantly destroys illusions.
notes.note1: The target will have a base movement speed of 120, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

abilities.name: Mana Drain
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%. 

 Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.

notes.note0: Prevents heroes from going invisible.

abilities.shard: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to  additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with % magic resistance while channeling.

abilities.name: To Hell and Back
abilities.desc:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

abilities.name: Finger of Death
abilities.desc:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with 250 range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. 

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.

notes.note0: Finger of Death has a 0.25 delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
notes.note1: Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within 3 seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.

notes.note0: The spikes move at 1600 units per second, over 750 range.
notes.note1: Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

abilities.name: Mind Flare
abilities.desc: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.

abilities.name: Spiked Carapace
abilities.desc:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.

notes.note0: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
notes.note1: Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled sources.
notes.note2: The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
notes.note3: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.desc: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.

notes.note0: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.

abilities.name: Mana Burn
abilities.desc: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Vendetta
abilities.desc: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has 75 additional attack range and a 70% faster attack animation for this attack.

notes.note0: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
notes.note1: With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.

abilities.shard: Decreases cooldown by bonus_AbilityCooldowns. For the first 0s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.

abilities.name: Fissure
abilities.desc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.

notes.note0: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
notes.note1: Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.

abilities.shard: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.

abilities.name: Enchant Totem
abilities.desc: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.

notes.note0: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.

abilities.scepter: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.

abilities.name: Aftershock
abilities.desc: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.

notes.note0: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.

abilities.name: Echo Slam
abilities.desc: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.

abilities.name: Slugger
abilities.desc: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

abilities.name: Cold Feet
abilities.desc: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4.0/4.0/4.0/4.0 seconds.

notes.note0: Deals damage every half second.

abilities.name: Ice Vortex
abilities.desc: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.

notes.note0: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.

abilities.name: Chilling Touch
abilities.desc: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
abilities.scepter: Removes cooldown.

abilities.name: Bone Chill
abilities.desc: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

abilities.name: Ice Blast
abilities.desc: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.

notes.note0: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
notes.note1: The area of effect is 300 + 50.0*TimeTraveled, capped at 1000.
notes.note2: Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
notes.note3: The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
notes.note4: The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.

abilities.shard: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for 0% of the duration.

abilities.name: Release
abilities.desc: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location. Can be cast while silenced.

abilities.name: Disruption
abilities.desc: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.

abilities.name: Disseminate
abilities.desc: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within 675 range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.

notes.note0: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Shadow Poison
abilities.desc: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to 5 stacks. Additional stacks cause 60 damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.

notes.note0: Shadow Poison can affect units under Disruption.

abilities.name: Demonic Cleanse
abilities.desc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration.  At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.

abilities.name: Demonic Purge
abilities.desc:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: The slow starts at 100% and decreases over time to 20%.
notes.note1: Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.

abilities.scepter: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain  charges.

abilities.name: Menace
abilities.desc: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for 8 seconds that increases their damage taken.

notes.note0: Break disables the application of new stacks.
notes.note1: Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

abilities.name: Laser
abilities.desc: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
abilities.scepter: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by % (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

abilities.name: March of the Machines
abilities.desc: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.

notes.note0: Robots spawn at a rate of 24 per second.

abilities.scepter: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.

abilities.name: Deploy Turrets
abilities.scepter: Turrets fire missiles 20% faster.

abilities.name: Warp Flare
abilities.desc:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.

notes.note0: Max teleportation distance is 60% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.

abilities.name: Keen Conveyance
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Teleport to a target friendly structure. Level 2 allows teleporting to friendly units and Level 3 to friendly heroes.

abilities.name: Rearm
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.desc: Tinker gains 1% item cooldown reduction per 3 Intelligence, up to a maximum of 60%.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.

notes.note0: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.desc: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is 175 range over 0.6 seconds.

notes.note0: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.

abilities.name: Chakra Magic
abilities.desc: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is 30% more effective when used on himself.

notes.note0: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.

abilities.name: Solar Bind
abilities.desc: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.

abilities.name: Will-O-Wisp
abilities.desc: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.

notes.note0: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.

abilities.name: Spirit Form
abilities.desc: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.

abilities.name: Bright Speed
abilities.desc:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every 3.0 Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves 300 distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see 400 range for 3.0 seconds.

abilities.name: Rocket Barrage
abilities.desc: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts 3 seconds.

notes.note0: Rocket Barrage can't hit units Gyrocopter has no vision over.
notes.note1: Rocket Barrage fired from Homing Missiles do not trigger Afterburner.

abilities.name: Homing Missile
abilities.desc: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.

notes.note0: Towers do half damage to the missile.
notes.note1: The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
notes.note2: The missile will follow and hit invisible units.

abilities.shard: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a  area of effect after  second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.

abilities.name: Flak Cannon
abilities.desc: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike.  Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.

notes.note0: Attack range for the primary attack is unchanged.

abilities.name: Afterburner
abilities.desc: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

notes.note0: Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.

abilities.name: Call Down
abilities.desc: Call down 3 aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is 500 distance from the previous one.

notes.note0: The visual indicator is visible to allies only.

abilities.name: Summon Wolves
abilities.desc: Summons 2 wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.

notes.note0: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.

abilities.shard: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.

abilities.name: Howl
abilities.desc: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within 2000 range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.

abilities.name: Feral Impulse
abilities.desc: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.

abilities.name: Wolf Bite
abilities.desc: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.

notes.note0: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.

abilities.name: Apex Predator
abilities.desc: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.desc: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.

notes.note0: Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.

abilities.name: Berserker's Call
abilities.desc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
abilities.shard: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.

abilities.name: Battle Hunger
abilities.desc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.

notes.note0: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.

abilities.name: Counter Helix
abilities.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.

notes.note0: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
notes.note1: Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.

abilities.scepter: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

abilities.name: Culling Blade
abilities.desc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

notes.note0: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

abilities.name: One Man Army
abilities.desc: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe.  The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

abilities.name: Quas
abilities.desc: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.

notes.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
notes.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

abilities.scepter: Grants 0 current and max level.

abilities.name: Wex
abilities.desc: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.

notes.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
notes.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

abilities.scepter: Grants 0 current and max level.

abilities.name: Exort
abilities.desc: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.

notes.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
notes.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

abilities.scepter: Grants 0 current and max level.

abilities.name: Invoke
abilities.desc:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each orb level.  Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels 6, 12, and 18.

Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options.  The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen.

 Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.

notes.note0: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
notes.note1: Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
notes.note2: Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.

notes.note0: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than 10.0 after reductions.

abilities.name: Ghost Walk
abilities.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.

notes.note0: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.

abilities.shard: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.

abilities.name: Tornado
abilities.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

abilities.scepter: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a 150 radius every 0.25 seconds. (half damage to creeps.)

abilities.name: E.M.P.
abilities.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 25% of the mana drained.

notes.note0: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).

abilities.shard: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at 0 units per second.

abilities.name: Alacrity
abilities.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.

abilities.name: Chaos Meteor
abilities.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.

notes.note0: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every 0.5 seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over 3.0 seconds.
notes.note1: The meteor moves at a speed of 300.

abilities.name: Sun Strike
abilities.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.

notes.note0: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
notes.note1: Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.

abilities.shard: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
abilities.scepter: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a 90 second cooldown. Creates 0 visible 75% damage Sun Strikes within 90-180 range of each enemy hero.

abilities.name: Forge Spirit
abilities.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.

notes.note0: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

abilities.name: Ice Wall
abilities.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.
abilities.scepter: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a 105 width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than 0 seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas.

abilities.name: Deafening Blast
abilities.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

abilities.name: Arcane Curse
abilities.desc:
Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.

Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.

notes.note0: Affects creeps.

abilities.name: Glaives of Wisdom
abilities.desc: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.

abilities.name: Last Word
abilities.desc: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.

notes.note0: Channeling abilities will trigger this effect once the caster finishes its channel.

abilities.name: Suffer In Silence
abilities.desc:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals 1 Intelligence from them.  If the victim was silenced, steal an extra 1 Intelligence.

abilities.name: Global Silence
abilities.desc: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.

notes.note0: This skill works on invisible and Debuff Immune units, but gaining debuff immunity will remove its effect.
notes.note1: Multiple Arcane Curses from Aghanim's Scepter Global Silence do not stack.

abilities.name: Waveform
abilities.desc: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.

abilities.name: Adaptive Strike
abilities.desc:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.

notes.note0: Projectile moves at 1150 speed.

abilities.name: Attribute Shift (Agility Gain)
abilities.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of 4/8/12/16. The process is reversible.

notes.note0: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
notes.note1: Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.

abilities.shard: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

abilities.name: Attribute Shift (Strength Gain)
abilities.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of 4/8/12/16. The process is reversible.

notes.note0: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
notes.note1: Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.

abilities.shard: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

abilities.name: Morph
abilities.desc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.

notes.note0: You can't target yourself with Morph.
notes.note1: Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
notes.note2: Does not trigger spell reflect.

abilities.scepter: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.

abilities.name: Morph Replicate
abilities.desc: Toggles Morphling's form between his own and the replicated enemy.

abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
abilities.desc: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.

notes.note0: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

abilities.name: Bloodrage
abilities.desc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.

notes.note0: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.

abilities.shard: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal 0% of the target's max health as Pure damage.

abilities.name: Blood Rite
abilities.desc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After 2.9 seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.

notes.note0: Total time is a 2.6 second delay plus a 0.3 second cast time.

abilities.name: Thirst
abilities.desc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.

notes.note0: Not triggered by Illusions.
notes.note1: Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below 25%.
notes.note2: Effects linger for 4.0 seconds if a target dies.

abilities.name: Sanguivore
abilities.desc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to 30 health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.

notes.note0: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by 40%.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.desc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.

abilities.name: Thunder Strike
abilities.desc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.3 seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
abilities.shard: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to 4 seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.

abilities.name: Glimpse
abilities.desc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4.0 seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.

notes.note0: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

abilities.name: Kinetic Field
abilities.desc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.

notes.note0: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.

abilities.name: Kinetic Fence
abilities.desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
abilities.desc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.

notes.note0: After 7s, the damage counter is reset.

abilities.name: Static Storm
abilities.desc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
abilities.scepter: Mutes items.

abilities.name: Magic Missile
abilities.desc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
abilities.shard: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within 75% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.

abilities.name: Wave of Terror
abilities.desc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.

abilities.name: Vengeance Aura
abilities.desc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives 25% extra bonus.

notes.note0: Break disables the damage aura.

abilities.scepter:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.desc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals 20% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

abilities.name: Nether Swap
abilities.desc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.

notes.note0: Works on Spell Immune units.
notes.note1: Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
notes.note2: Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

abilities.name: Purification
abilities.desc: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.

abilities.name: Repel
abilities.desc: Grants Debuff Immunity with 60% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.

abilities.name: Hammer of Purity
abilities.desc:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

 Omniknight heals for 40% of the damage dealt over 4s.

abilities.name: Degen Aura
abilities.desc: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.

notes.note0: Does not affect Debuff Immune units.

abilities.name: Guardian Angel
abilities.desc: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
abilities.scepter: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.

abilities.name: Arctic Burn
abilities.desc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of 4/6/8/10% of their current health each second.

notes.note0: This ability does not affect Roshan.
notes.note1: Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to 0.1.
notes.note2: The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.

abilities.scepter: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.

abilities.name: Splinter Blast
abilities.desc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a 500 base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by 27/30/33/36%.

notes.note0: The primary projectile moves at 1200 movement speed.
notes.note1: The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.

abilities.name: Cold Embrace
abilities.desc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
abilities.shard: Reduces cooldown by  seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.

abilities.name: Winter's Curse
abilities.desc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.

notes.note0: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
notes.note1: Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.

abilities.name: Mist Coil
abilities.desc: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.

notes.note0: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.

abilities.name: Aphotic Shield
abilities.desc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
notes.note1: The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.

abilities.name: Curse of Avernus
abilities.desc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.

abilities.name: Withering Mist
abilities.desc: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5.0s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 29.5% if they are below 40.0% HP.

abilities.name: Borrowed Time
abilities.desc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below 400.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced.  The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
notes.note1: Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
notes.note2: Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.

abilities.scepter: Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than  damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.

abilities.name: Flux
abilities.desc: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
abilities.scepter: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.

abilities.name: Magnetic Field
abilities.desc: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.

abilities.name: Spark Wraith
abilities.desc: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.

notes.note0: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.

abilities.name: Runic Infusion
abilities.desc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +1.5 all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

abilities.name: Tempest Double
abilities.desc:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.

notes.note0: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.

abilities.shard:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for 0s when created.

Does not trigger Runic Infusion.

abilities.name: Fatal Bonds
abilities.desc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.

notes.note0: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
notes.note1: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Shadow Word
abilities.desc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to 10/12/14/16 seconds. Enemies are slowed for 1.0 second after leaving the area or the spell ends.

notes.note0: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.

abilities.shard: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every 2 seconds that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

abilities.name: Eldritch Summoning
abilities.desc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.

notes.note0: Minor imps do not explode if killed by enemy heroes.

abilities.name: Chaotic Offering
abilities.desc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 0.8 seconds. The Golem lives 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.

notes.note0: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.

abilities.scepter: Calls  Golems.

abilities.name: Hoof Stomp
abilities.desc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

abilities.name: Double Edge
abilities.desc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.

notes.note0: Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.

abilities.shard: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of  stacks.

abilities.name: Retaliate
abilities.desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.

notes.note0: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
notes.note1: Retaliate deals damage to towers.
notes.note2: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Work Horse
abilities.desc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.desc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.

abilities.name: Horsepower
abilities.desc:
Centaur Warrunner gains 40% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

abilities.name: Insatiable Hunger
abilities.desc: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.

abilities.name: Spin Web
abilities.desc:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.

notes.note0: Also affects Spiderlings.

abilities.name: Incapacitating Bite
abilities.desc: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.

notes.note0: The miss chance stacks with evasion and terrain dodge chance.

abilities.name: Spider's Milk
abilities.desc: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.

abilities.name: Spawn Spiderlings
abilities.desc: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for 4 seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.

notes.note0: If the target is killed within 20 seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
notes.note1: Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.

abilities.name: Static Remnant
abilities.desc: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for 12.0 seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.

notes.note0: Remnants take 0.75 second to materialize after the spell is cast.
notes.note1: Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
notes.note2: The explosion actually hits units in a 300 radius, but will only be triggered in 235.
notes.note3: Can be self-cast to cast in place.

abilities.name: Electric Vortex
abilities.desc: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
abilities.scepter: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.desc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

notes.note0: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
notes.note1: Overload charges do not stack.

abilities.shard: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes  Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to  seconds or until the charges are depleted.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.desc: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is 25+7.5% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is 10+0.65% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.

notes.note0: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
notes.note1: This ability will destroy trees.
notes.note2: Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.

abilities.name: Galvanized
abilities.desc: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every 3 levels. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.

notes.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.

abilities.name: Gush
abilities.desc: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
abilities.scepter: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.

abilities.name: Kraken Shell
abilities.desc:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of 40% movement speed. Lasts 4.0s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: Does not stack with items that provide Damage Block.

abilities.name: Anchor Smash
abilities.desc: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus 225 units.

notes.note0: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
notes.note1: Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Dead in the Water
abilities.desc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.desc: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.

notes.note0: Ravage will hit invisible units.
notes.note1: Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of 725.

abilities.name: Echo Slash
abilities.desc: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.

notes.note0: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.

abilities.name: Grappling Claw
abilities.desc: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.

abilities.name: Kazurai Katana
abilities.desc:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. 

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
abilities.shard: Kez lifesteals 0% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

abilities.name: Switch Discipline
abilities.desc:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
abilities.scepter:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within 3 seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

abilities.name: Raptor Dance
abilities.desc:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1.0 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.

notes.note0: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to 20% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

abilities.name: Falcon Rush
abilities.desc: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.

notes.note0: Does not work on buildings.

abilities.name: Talon Toss
abilities.desc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.

notes.note0: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

abilities.name: Shodo Sai
abilities.desc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for 1.5 seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for 0.4s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.

abilities.name: Raven's Veil
abilities.desc: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

abilities.name: Catchy Lick
abilities.desc:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Can lick runes to pull them.

abilities.name: Frogstomp
abilities.desc: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every 1 second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.

abilities.name: Croak of Genius
abilities.desc:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following 5 seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by 0.5s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.

notes.note0: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
notes.note1: Only applies to damage where the source and target are within 2000 units of each other.

abilities.name: Encore
abilities.desc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.

abilities.name: Amphibian Rhapsody
abilities.desc:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.

notes.note0: Items can be used while in this mode.

abilities.name: Bullbelly Blitz
abilities.desc: Largo plays a song that deals 20/30/40 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.

abilities.name: Hotfeet Hustle
abilities.desc: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

abilities.name: Island Elixir
abilities.desc: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.desc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

abilities.name: Cinder Brew
abilities.desc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed.  If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by 3s and causing them to take damage over time.

abilities.name: Drunken Brawler
abilities.desc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s.  If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.

notes.note0: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

abilities.name: Liquid Courage
abilities.desc: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.

abilities.name: Primal Split
abilities.desc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.

notes.note0: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
notes.note1: The Fire Element has phased movement.
notes.note2: When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.

abilities.name: Boulder Smash
abilities.desc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a 200 radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

abilities.name: Rolling Boulder
abilities.desc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60/70/80/90 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.

notes.note0: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
notes.note1: The boulder has a radius of 160.
notes.note2: Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.

abilities.name: Geomagnetic Grip
abilities.desc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.

notes.note0: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
notes.note1: Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.

abilities.name: Stone Remnant
abilities.desc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location.  Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.  Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 3.0% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5% bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).

abilities.name: Enchant Remnant
abilities.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. 

Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.

notes.note0: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.

abilities.name: Magnetize
abilities.desc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.

abilities.name: Reflection
abilities.desc: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.

notes.note0: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
notes.note1: Reflections can only attack their source.

abilities.name: Conjure Image
abilities.desc: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.

notes.note0: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.desc: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within 1200 range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.

notes.note0: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.

abilities.name: Demon Zeal
abilities.desc: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.

abilities.name: Terror Wave
abilities.desc: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.desc: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.

notes.note0: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.

abilities.name: Dark Unity
abilities.desc: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.

notes.note0: Reflection Illusions are also affected.

abilities.name: Arcane Orb
abilities.desc: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.

notes.note0: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.

abilities.name: Astral Imprisonment
abilities.desc: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.

notes.note0: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
notes.note1: Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.

abilities.shard: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at 0% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).

abilities.name: Objurgation
abilities.desc: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.

abilities.name: Essence Flux
abilities.desc: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.

abilities.name: Sanity's Eclipse
abilities.desc: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.

abilities.name: Icarus Dive
abilities.desc: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.

notes.note0: Icarus Dive has a 2.0 second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.

abilities.name: Fire Spirits
abilities.desc: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.

notes.note0: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.

abilities.shard: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.

abilities.name: Sun Ray
abilities.desc: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.

notes.note0: Sun Ray has a width of 130 units, and a length of 1200 units.
notes.note1: Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
notes.note2: Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.

abilities.shard: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.

abilities.name: Dying Light
abilities.desc: Phoenix deals 3.5% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a 400 radius every second.

notes.note0: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.desc:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After 6.0 seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.scepter: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.

abilities.name: Paralyzing Cask
abilities.desc: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.

notes.note0: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.

abilities.name: Voodoo Restoration
abilities.desc: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.

notes.note0: Healing is done in 0.33/0.33/0.33/0.33 second intervals.
notes.note1: Can heal Spell Immune units.

abilities.name: Maledict
abilities.desc: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.

notes.note0: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.

abilities.name: Voodoo Switcheroo
abilities.desc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

abilities.name: Gris-Gris
abilities.desc:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s. 

 Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

abilities.name: Death Ward
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8.0 seconds. Death Ward has 50% bonus accuracy.

notes.note0: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
notes.note1: The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
notes.note2: Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.

abilities.scepter: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Spear of Mars
abilities.desc: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.

notes.note0: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
notes.note1: Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.

abilities.shard: Spear of Mars impales up to 1 heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.

abilities.name: God's Rebuke
abilities.desc: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.

notes.note0: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.desc:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

 Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.

notes.note0: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
notes.note1: Break disables the front and side damage reduction.

abilities.scepter: Creates  invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.

abilities.name: Dauntless
abilities.desc: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in 900 radius.

abilities.name: Arena Of Blood
abilities.desc: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
abilities.scepter: Lowers cooldown by bonus_AbilityCooldowns and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore 0%  of their max health and mana and get a 0%  attack damage buff for 0s. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Frost Blast
abilities.desc: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for 4.0 seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.

abilities.name: Frost Shield
abilities.desc: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1.0 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.

notes.note0: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
notes.note1: Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.

abilities.name: Sinister Gaze
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
abilities.scepter: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of  in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

abilities.name: Ice Spire
abilities.desc:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take 4 hero hits or 8 creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

abilities.name: Sacrifice
abilities.desc:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.

notes.note0: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
notes.note1: Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

abilities.name: Chain Frost
abilities.desc: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to 10/10/10 times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.

notes.note0: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
notes.note1: Chain Frost has a movement speed of 850.
notes.note2: Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.

abilities.name: Ice Shards
abilities.desc: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for 4/5/6/7 seconds.

notes.note0: Creates an impassable barrier.

abilities.name: Snowball
abilities.desc: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a 325 radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving.
