Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.

notes.note0: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
notes.note1: The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
notes.note2: Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
notes.note3: Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
notes.note4: Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.

abilities.name: Tag Team
abilities.desc: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts 6 seconds.

notes.note0: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.

abilities.name: Drinking Buddies
abilities.desc: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.

notes.note0: Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within 250 range of each other.
notes.note1: Cannot be used during Snowball.

abilities.name: Walrus Kick
abilities.desc: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.

abilities.name: Walrus PUNCH!
abilities.desc: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.

notes.note0: Walrus PUNCH has true strike.

abilities.name: Bitter Chill
abilities.desc: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a 350 unit radius.

abilities.name: Starstorm
abilities.desc: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a 675 radius will be struck a second time.

notes.note0: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
notes.note1: Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
notes.note2: Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.

abilities.name: Sacred Arrow
abilities.desc: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.3/3.2/4.1/5.0 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.

notes.note0: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
notes.note1: Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
notes.note2: Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.

abilities.scepter: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.desc: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts 5 seconds.
abilities.shard: Grants +0 Leap charge.

abilities.name: Celestial Quiver
abilities.desc: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Moonlight Shadow
abilities.desc: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.

notes.note0: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.

abilities.name: Ether Shock
abilities.desc: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.

notes.note0: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.

abilities.name: Hex
abilities.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.

notes.note0: Instantly destroys illusions.
notes.note1: The target will have a base movement speed of 100, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

abilities.name: Shackles
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

abilities.name: Fowl Play
abilities.desc:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
notes.note1: Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.

abilities.name: Urnaconda
abilities.desc: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts 15s.

abilities.name: Mass Serpent Ward
abilities.desc: Summons 10 Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.

abilities.name: Void
abilities.desc: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.

notes.note0: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.

abilities.name: Crippling Fear
abilities.desc: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.

abilities.name: Hunter in the Night
abilities.desc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
abilities.shard: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.

abilities.name: Dark Ascension
abilities.desc: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.

abilities.name: Storm Hammer
abilities.desc: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

abilities.name: Great Cleave
abilities.desc: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.

abilities.name: Warcry
abilities.desc: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 8 seconds.
abilities.shard: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a  physical damage barrier.

abilities.name: God's Strength
abilities.desc: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for 30.0 seconds.

notes.note0: The bonus damage is based on base damage and the primary attribute of Sven.

abilities.name: Wrath of God
abilities.desc: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

abilities.name: Battle Stance
abilities.desc:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to 1.4.

Troll Warlord gains 1.0 armor per 30 bonus attack speed.

abilities.name: Whirling Axes (Ranged)
abilities.desc: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over 950.0 range, slowing and damaging enemy units.

notes.note0: Does not affect Roshan.
notes.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.scepter:
Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Whirling Axes (Melee)
abilities.desc: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.

notes.note0: Does not affect Roshan.

abilities.scepter:
Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Fervor
abilities.desc: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.

notes.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note1: Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.

abilities.shard: Grants Troll % + % chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus  when attacking an enemy unit.

abilities.name: Berserker's Rage
abilities.desc:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

abilities.name: Battle Trance
abilities.desc:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within 900 range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
notes.note1: Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
notes.note2: Troll is granted vision over the target.

abilities.name: Decay
abilities.desc: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals 2.0x damage to creeps.

notes.note0: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
notes.note1: The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.
notes.note2: Affects invisible units.

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.desc: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.

notes.note0: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
notes.note1: Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
notes.note2: Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.

abilities.name: Tombstone
abilities.desc: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.

notes.note0: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
notes.note1: Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
notes.note2: If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.

abilities.shard: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for 2 seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Flesh Golem
abilities.desc: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.

abilities.name: Earthshock
abilities.desc: Ursa leaps forward 250 units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for 4.0 seconds.
abilities.shard: Earthshock applies  Fury Swipes to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.desc: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.

notes.note0: Missing an attack still consumes a charge of Overpower.

abilities.name: Fury Swipes
abilities.desc: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after 8/12/16/20 seconds, the bonus damage is lost.

notes.note0: Break disables the application of new stacks.
notes.note1: Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.desc: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.desc:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.scepter: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.

abilities.name: Frost Arrows
abilities.desc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts 1.5 seconds.

notes.note0: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.

abilities.scepter: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.desc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.

abilities.name: Multishot
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + 475. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.

notes.note0: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
notes.note1: Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

abilities.name: Glacier
abilities.desc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

abilities.name: Precision Aura
abilities.desc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received 50% of the bonus agility.

abilities.name: Marksmanship
abilities.desc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within 300 range.

notes.note0: Marksmanship procs have true strike.

abilities.name: Fireblast
abilities.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.

notes.note0: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a 0.6 seconds interval.

abilities.name: Ignite
abilities.desc: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.

notes.note0: Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a 1400 area of effect.
notes.note1: Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.desc: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.

notes.note0: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 700 area of effect to receive Bloodlust.

abilities.name: Unrefined Fireblast
abilities.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.

notes.note0: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a 0.6 seconds interval.

abilities.name: Fire Shield
abilities.desc: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.

notes.note0: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 1000 area of effect to receive Fire Shield.

abilities.name: Multicast
abilities.desc: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every 16 Strength adds 1%.

notes.note0: Only targeted abilities and items have a chance to be multicast.
notes.note1: Targeted abilities and items apply to additional enemies and neutrals in an AoE around Ogre. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast hit the same target multiple times.

abilities.name: Echo Stomp
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.

notes.note0: If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.

abilities.shard: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.

abilities.name: Astral Spirit
abilities.desc:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
abilities.scepter: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain 50% magic resistance for  seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.

abilities.name: Natural Order
abilities.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.

notes.note0: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.desc: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.

notes.note0: Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
notes.note1: Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.

abilities.name: Earth Splitter
abilities.desc: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.desc: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.

abilities.name: Burning Spear
abilities.desc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.

notes.note0: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
notes.note1: Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
notes.note2: Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.

abilities.scepter: Burning Spears launches an additional multishot_targets spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.

abilities.name: Berserker's Blood
abilities.desc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.

notes.note0: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than 10% HP.

abilities.name: Blood Magic
abilities.desc:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

abilities.name: Life Break
abilities.desc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
notes.note1: Slow works on Spell Immune units.
notes.note2: Life Break cannot be disjointed.

abilities.scepter: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.desc:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies 2 stacks to each enemy hero in the area and 5 stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for 10s, making him apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.

notes.note0: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
notes.note1: Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
notes.note2: Entangled debuff is dispellable.
notes.note3: Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
notes.note4: Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.

abilities.name: Spirit Link
abilities.desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.

notes.note0: Break disables the shared lifesteal.

abilities.name: Savage Roar
abilities.desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by 20%.

notes.note0: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
notes.note1: Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.

abilities.shard:
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Summon Spirit Bear
abilities.desc:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers 20.0% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.

notes.note0: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
notes.note1: Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and base_magic_resistance% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
notes.note2: Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
notes.note3: Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
notes.note4: Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

abilities.name: True Form
abilities.desc: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.

abilities.name: Onslaught
abilities.desc:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.desc: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every 140 units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.

abilities.name: Uproar
abilities.desc:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of 50 hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for 7 seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.

notes.note0: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
notes.note1: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

abilities.name: Rock Throw
abilities.desc:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.

abilities.name: Pulverize
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts 2.3 seconds.

abilities.name: Fortune's End
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Affects invulnerable units.

abilities.name: Fate's Edict
abilities.desc: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them 100% magic damage resistance.

abilities.name: Purifying Flames
abilities.desc: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.

notes.note0: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
notes.note1: The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.

abilities.name: Rain of Destiny
abilities.desc: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.

abilities.name: False Promise
abilities.desc:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
notes.note1: The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.

abilities.name: Spectral Dagger
abilities.desc: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.

notes.note0: There is a 1.0 second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
notes.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.desc:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

abilities.name: Dispersion
abilities.desc: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.

notes.note0: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
notes.note1: Illusions don't get this ability.
notes.note2: Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
notes.note3: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.shard: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by 0% of its base values for 0s. Cooldown 0. Manacost 0.

abilities.name: Reality
abilities.desc: Spectre assumes the target Shadow Step or Haunt illusion, destroying it.
abilities.shard: Reality also casts Spectral Dagger on the illusion's target.

abilities.name: Desolate
abilities.desc: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a 350 radius around them.

notes.note0: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
notes.note1: Spectre's illusions also have Desolate.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.desc:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.  They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

abilities.name: Boundless Strike
abilities.desc: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.

abilities.name: Tree Dance
abilities.desc: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for 3.0s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.

notes.note0: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
notes.note1: Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
notes.note2: Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.

abilities.name: Primal Spring
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Monkey King springs out from his tree perch, damaging and slowing enemies in the area where he lands. Damage and slow amounts are in proportion to channel duration.

abilities.name: Jingu Mastery
abilities.desc: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.

notes.note0: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
notes.note1: Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
notes.note2: Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
notes.note3: Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
notes.note4: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note5: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Mischief
abilities.desc: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for 0.1 seconds upon transforming.

abilities.name: Wukong's Command
abilities.desc:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of 1.1s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.

notes.note0: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
notes.note1: Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.

abilities.scepter: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.

abilities.name: Sticky Napalm
abilities.desc: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to 20 stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.

notes.note0: All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
notes.note1: Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
notes.note2: Sticky Napalm deals 20% damage to creeps.

abilities.shard:
Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.

Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.

abilities.name: Flamebreak
abilities.desc: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Firefly
abilities.desc: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.

notes.note0: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
notes.note1: If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
notes.note2: The trail persists through Batrider's death.

abilities.name: Smoldering Resin
abilities.desc: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals 20% of the attack damage every 1s for 2s.

abilities.name: Flaming Lasso
abilities.desc: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.

notes.note0: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
notes.note1: If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
notes.note2: Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.

abilities.scepter: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within  units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.

abilities.name: Dark Pact
abilities.desc:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes 30% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: 1.5 seconds after cast, a series of 10 pulses separated by 0.1 seconds deal the damage.
notes.note1: Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
notes.note2: You can't kill yourself with this skill.
notes.note3: The pulses stop if Slark dies.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.desc: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.

notes.note0: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of 933.33, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled 700 distance.
notes.note1: Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
notes.note2: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.

abilities.scepter: Provides charges and increases range.

abilities.name: Saltwater Shiv
abilities.desc:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

abilities.name: Depth Shroud
abilities.desc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

abilities.name: Essence Shift
abilities.desc: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.

notes.note0: Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
notes.note1: Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
notes.note2: To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
notes.note3: Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
notes.note4: Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.

abilities.name: Shadow Dance
abilities.desc:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.  If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for 2.0 seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

abilities.name: The Swarm
abilities.desc: Weaver launches a swarm of 12/12/12/12 young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.

notes.note0: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
notes.note1: Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in 6/7/8/9 attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.
notes.note2: Beetles provide vision.

abilities.name: Shukuchi
abilities.desc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.

notes.note0: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.

abilities.name: Geminate Attack
abilities.desc: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.

notes.note0: Additional attacks leave Weaver 0.25 seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
notes.note1: Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.

abilities.shard: Geminate Attack will also hit units within  range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.

abilities.name: Time Lapse
abilities.desc:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
notes.note1: Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.

abilities.scepter: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with 500 cast range.

abilities.name: Threads of Fate
abilities.desc: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

abilities.name: Impetus
abilities.desc: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is.  The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.

notes.note0: The damage is capped at 1750 distance.
notes.note1: Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.

abilities.name: Enchant
abilities.desc:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5/4/4.5/5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30/60/90/120s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Illusions can be converted.

abilities.scepter: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.

abilities.name: Nature's Attendants
abilities.desc: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.

notes.note0: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.

abilities.name: Sproink
abilities.desc: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.

abilities.name: Little Friends
abilities.desc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.desc: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.

notes.note0: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
notes.note1: The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.

abilities.name: Rabble-Rouser
abilities.desc: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.

notes.note0: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.

abilities.name: Vacuum
abilities.desc: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.

notes.note0: This ability interrupts channeling.
notes.note1: Pulls units over 0.3/0.4/0.5/0.6 seconds before dealing damage.
notes.note2: Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.

abilities.name: Ion Shell
abilities.desc: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.

notes.note0: Deals small amounts of damage in 0.2 second intervals.
notes.note1: Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
notes.note2: If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.

abilities.name: Surge
abilities.desc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.

notes.note0: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.

abilities.name: Normal Punch
abilities.desc: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3.0 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.

abilities.name: Quick Wit
abilities.desc:
Dark Seer gains 1.0 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

abilities.name: Wall of Replica
abilities.desc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.

notes.note0: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
notes.note1: There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.desc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.

notes.note0: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
notes.note1: Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.

abilities.name: Tidebringer
abilities.desc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.

abilities.name: X Marks the Spot
abilities.desc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.

notes.note0: Interrupts channeling spells.
Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

abilities.name: Tidal Wave
abilities.desc: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

abilities.name: Ghostship
abilities.desc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a 2x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.

notes.note0: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
notes.note1: The boat has a movement speed of 650.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Odds
abilities.desc: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a 100% impact slow for 0.3s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
abilities.shard: Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.

abilities.name: Press The Attack
abilities.desc:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

abilities.name: Moment of Courage
abilities.desc: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.

notes.note0: The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.

abilities.name: Outfight Them!
abilities.desc: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6.0s; allies gain 50% of the value.  This bonus stacks independently.

abilities.name: Duel
abilities.desc: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.

notes.note0: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.

abilities.name: Bramble Maze
abilities.desc: Dark Willow creates a 500 AoE maze of 8 brambles that grow in the target area after 0.3 seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts 12 seconds.

notes.note0: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.

abilities.name: Shadow Realm
abilities.desc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3.0 seconds.

notes.note0: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
notes.note1: Grants phased movement.
notes.note2: Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.

abilities.scepter: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.

abilities.name: Cursed Crown
abilities.desc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
abilities.shard: Cursed Crown creates  brambles in a  radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Bedlam
abilities.desc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.

abilities.name: Pixie Dust
abilities.desc: Dark Willow gains 20% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to 100% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

abilities.name: Terrorize
abilities.desc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.

notes.note0: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.

abilities.name: Crypt Swarm
abilities.desc: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.

notes.note0: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
notes.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.desc: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.

notes.note0: Doesn't prevent usage of items.

abilities.name: Spirit Siphon
abilities.desc: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.

notes.note0: Cannot cast multiple on same target.

abilities.shard: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by  and causes enemies to be feared for  seconds if they are siphoned for  seconds consecutively.

abilities.name: Exorcism
abilities.desc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts 40 seconds.

notes.note0: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
notes.note1: Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.

abilities.scepter: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

abilities.name: Refraction
abilities.desc: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.

notes.note0: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).

abilities.name: Meld
abilities.desc: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for 6 seconds. Bonus damage and debuffs from Meld are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.

notes.note0: Meld is broken by any action other than staying in position or channeling Psionic Projection.
notes.note1: Meld's armor reduction does not work against towers.

abilities.name: Psi Blades
abilities.desc: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.

notes.note0: Split damage hits invisible units.
notes.note1: Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.

abilities.name: Trap
abilities.desc:
Springs the trap nearest to Templar Assassin, slowing nearby enemies. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, springs the trap that is closest to the mouse cursor.

abilities.name: Psionic Projection
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.

abilities.name: Psionic Trap
abilities.desc: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of 20% in a 400 radius. Trap movement slow charges up to 50% after 3.5 seconds. Deals damage after 3.5s.

notes.note0: Traps last indefinitely.
notes.note1: They have invisibility that fades in over 2.0/2.0/2.0 seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
notes.note2: Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.

abilities.scepter: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.

abilities.name: Inner Peace
abilities.desc: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for 0.2s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after 1.85s of meditating.

abilities.name: Whirling Death
abilities.desc: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.

abilities.name: Timber Chain
abilities.desc: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it.  Any enemy in the path takes damage.

abilities.name: Reactive Armor
abilities.desc: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as 4x the amount.

notes.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note1: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Flamethrower
abilities.desc: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.

abilities.name: Chakram
abilities.desc: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.

notes.note0: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over 2000.0 distance away.

abilities.name: Return Chakram
abilities.desc: Returns the Chakram to Timbersaw.

abilities.name: Exposure Therapy
abilities.desc: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

abilities.name: Venomous Gale
abilities.desc: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.

notes.note0: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
notes.note1: Duration damage is dealt every 3.0/3.0/3.0/3.0 seconds.
notes.note2: Slow starts at -35/-40/-45/-50%, and decreases as time passes.

abilities.shard: Increases cast range and projectile speed by %. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, 0 Plague Wards are created around them.

abilities.name: Snakebite
abilities.desc: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

abilities.name: Plague Ward
abilities.desc: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.

abilities.name: Poison Sting
abilities.desc: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.

notes.note0: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
notes.note1: Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.

abilities.name: Noxious Plague
abilities.desc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.

notes.note0: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.desc: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.desc:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with 30% larger bonus.

notes.note0: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
notes.note1: Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
notes.note2: Ranged units cannot Cleave.

abilities.name: Skewer
abilities.desc: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.

notes.note0: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.

abilities.shard: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.

abilities.name: Horn Toss
abilities.desc: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

abilities.name: Solid Core
abilities.desc: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.desc: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.

notes.note0: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
notes.note1: If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.

abilities.name: Scorched Earth
abilities.desc: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.

notes.note0: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

abilities.name: Infernal Blade
abilities.desc: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.66 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.

notes.note0: Interrupts channeling abilities.

abilities.name: Doom
abilities.desc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.scepter: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a 0 radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.

abilities.name: Lvl ? Pain
abilities.desc: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After 2.5s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a 66 AoE for 10% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is 66% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of 6.

notes.note0: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.

abilities.name: Arc Lightning
abilities.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.desc: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 600 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 325 range.

notes.note0: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

abilities.name: Heavenly Jump
abilities.desc: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Nimbus
abilities.desc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.

notes.note0: Grants 125 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
notes.note1: Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
notes.note2: Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.

abilities.name: Lightning Hands
abilities.desc: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

abilities.name: Thundergod's Wrath
abilities.desc: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.

abilities.name: Static Field
abilities.desc: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

abilities.name: Dispose
abilities.desc: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.

abilities.name: Rebound
abilities.desc:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives 25% bonus movement speed for 4.0s.

notes.note0: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
notes.note1: Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes.note2: Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.

abilities.name: Bodyguard
abilities.desc:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with 75% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, 30% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.

notes.note0: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
notes.note1: Lifesteal effectiveness gets a 40% penalty against creeps.
notes.note2: The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.

abilities.name: Special Delivery
abilities.desc:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.

notes.note0: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of 1.0 second.
notes.note1: If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.

abilities.name: Unleash
abilities.desc:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for 2.0s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for 1.5s.

Marci gains 15% movement speed when Unleash is cast.

notes.note0: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
notes.note1: Removes attack speed limit.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.desc: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.

notes.note0: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

abilities.name: Shallow Grave
abilities.desc: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.

notes.note0: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

abilities.name: Shadow Wave
abilities.desc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.

notes.note0: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
notes.note1: If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.

abilities.name: Weave
abilities.desc: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.

abilities.name: Nothl Projection
abilities.desc: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.

notes.note0: Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.

abilities.name: Swashbuckle
abilities.desc:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.

notes.note0: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

abilities.name: Shield Crash
abilities.desc:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
abilities.scepter: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals 75% damage.

abilities.name: Lucky Shot
abilities.desc: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.

abilities.name: Roll Up
abilities.desc: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, 80% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.

abilities.name: Rolling Thunder
abilities.desc:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with 80% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
notes.note1: If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
notes.note2: It takes Pangolier 1.0s to reach full roll speed.

abilities.name: Stop Rolling
abilities.desc: Halt!

abilities.name: Fortune Favors the Bold
abilities.desc: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.

notes.note0: Applies to hero abilities and items.
notes.note1: Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.

abilities.name: Dual Breath
abilities.desc: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.

notes.note0: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
notes.note1: Has a 0.2 second interval between each breath.
notes.note2: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: Ice Path
abilities.desc: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.

notes.note0: It takes 0.2 seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
notes.note1: The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.

abilities.name: Liquid Fire
abilities.desc: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.

notes.note0: Works on both units and buildings.

abilities.name: Liquid Frost
abilities.desc: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5.0 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

abilities.name: Double Trouble
abilities.desc: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.

notes.note0: The second attack ignores Damage Block.

abilities.name: Macropyre
abilities.desc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.

notes.note0: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for 1 additional seconds.

abilities.scepter: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by 0%.

abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.desc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.

notes.note0: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
notes.note1: Doesn't prevent the use of active items.

abilities.shard: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by 0 and cannot be targeted by their allies.

abilities.name: Blink Strike
abilities.desc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by 100% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

notes.note0: You can Blink Strike to allies, but no damage is dealt.

abilities.name: Tricks of the Trade
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes 2 random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.

notes.note0: Backstab damage is applied to all units hit.

abilities.scepter: Increases Cast Range to 400. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have % bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts s longer and does an additional  attacks.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.desc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.

notes.note0: Works when denying friendly units at 30% effectiveness.
notes.note1: Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.

abilities.name: Cloak and Dagger
abilities.desc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

abilities.name: Earthbind
abilities.desc: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.

notes.note0: Affects invisible units, revealing them.
notes.note1: Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.

abilities.name: Poof
abilities.desc:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for 1.5 seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.

notes.note0: Can be cast through the minimap.
notes.note1: Can teleport to Meepo illusions.

abilities.name: Ransack
abilities.desc:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.

notes.note0: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification

abilities.name: Dig
abilities.desc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: MegaMeepo
abilities.desc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.

abilities.name: Divided We Stand
abilities.desc:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. 

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them 50/66/75/80% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.

abilities.name: Geomancy
abilities.desc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain.  Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within 250 range, he receives 1 HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives 2% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by 2% for 2 seconds.

notes.note0: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.
Does not trigger spell reflect.

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.desc: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.

notes.note0: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
notes.note1: Arcane Bolt cannot be disjointed.

abilities.shard: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, 1 bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: Concussive Shot
abilities.desc: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.

notes.note0: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
notes.note1: Damages creeps around the impact area.
notes.note2: Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.

abilities.scepter: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within  range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: Ancient Seal
abilities.desc: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.

notes.note0: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.

abilities.scepter: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within  range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: Shield of the Scion
abilities.desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.

abilities.name: Mystic Flare
abilities.desc: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over 2.0 seconds.

notes.note0: Mystic Flare only affects Heroes. Mystic Flare does not damage creep heroes.
notes.note1: Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
notes.note2: Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.

abilities.scepter: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within  range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

abilities.name: Shackleshot
abilities.desc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to 0.6.

notes.note0: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
notes.note1: Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most 575 behind the target.
notes.note2: Shackleshot can be disjointed.

abilities.name: Powershot
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to 1.0 second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.

notes.note0: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.

abilities.name: Windrun
abilities.desc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

abilities.name: Gale Force
abilities.desc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

abilities.name: Focus Fire
abilities.desc: Windranger channels the wind to gain 350/425/500 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.

notes.note0: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
notes.note1: Windranger can move while attacking.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.desc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.

abilities.name: Sprout
abilities.desc: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a 400 radius.

notes.note0: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
notes.note1: Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.

abilities.name: Teleportation
abilities.desc: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.

notes.note0: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
notes.note1: When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

abilities.name: Nature's Call
abilities.desc: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.

notes.note0: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.

abilities.name: Curse of the Oldgrowth
abilities.desc: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Forest
abilities.desc: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.

notes.note0: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
notes.note1: Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.

abilities.name: Wrath of Nature
abilities.desc: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after 16 are hit.

notes.note0: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
notes.note1: Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.

abilities.scepter: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from s up to s seconds at max bounce.

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
