abilities.desc: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Reactive Tazer
abilities.desc:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.

abilities.name: Blast Off!
abilities.desc: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

notes.note0: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.
notes.note1: This ability destroys trees.

abilities.name: M.A.D.
abilities.desc:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after 1.5s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.

abilities.name: Minefield Sign
abilities.desc:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.

abilities.name: Proximity Mines
abilities.desc: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active 500 AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for 1.0 seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within 150 radius and decreases down to 50% on the edge. Deals 30% damage to buildings.

notes.note0: Cannot be placed within 350 AoE of another Proximity Mine.
notes.note1: Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
notes.note2: Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
notes.note3: Mines are triggered by invisible units.
notes.note4: Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.desc:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Open Wounds
abilities.desc: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.

notes.note0: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
notes.note1: The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.desc: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.

notes.note0: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
notes.note1: The heal is independent of the damage.
notes.note2: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note3: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Ghoul Frenzy
abilities.desc: Passively grants Lifestealer Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Infest
abilities.desc:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
notes.note1: Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
notes.note2: Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes.note3: Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.

abilities.shard: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to bonus_AbilityCooldowns.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.

abilities.name: Consume
abilities.desc: Lifestealer eats the host body from the inside out, exploding from within.

abilities.name: Nether Blast
abilities.desc: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area.  Deals 65% damage to structures.

notes.note0: Damage is delayed by 0.8 seconds.

abilities.name: Decrepify
abilities.desc: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.

notes.note0: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
notes.note1: Doesn't slow allied units.
notes.note2: Can be used on your Nether Ward.

abilities.name: Nether Ward
abilities.desc: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.

notes.note0: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
notes.note1: Nether Ward can be decrepified.
notes.note2: Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.

abilities.shard: Increases cast range to 175.

abilities.name: Oblivion Savant
abilities.desc:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives 1.5% spell amplification per destroyed tower.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
abilities.shard: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within 700 units of the ward for % of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
abilities.scepter: Reduces cooldown by 7s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by % per second up to a maximum of % and increases his own, up to a maximum of %. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is % instead. Debuff lasts  seconds.

abilities.name: Scatterblast
abilities.desc: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by 25% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by 50% for enemies caught at point-blank range.

abilities.name: Firesnap Cookie
abilities.desc: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.

notes.note0: The cookie projectile has a speed of 1200.

abilities.shard: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does 40% impact damage to the landing destination.

abilities.name: Lil' Shredder
abilities.desc: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire 5 attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.

notes.note0: Sets base attack time to 1.0s for the duration.
notes.note1: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.

abilities.name: Gobble Up
abilities.desc: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to  seconds.

notes.note0: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.

abilities.name: Spit Out
abilities.desc: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.

abilities.name: Mortimer Kisses
abilities.desc: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.

notes.note0: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
notes.note1: Has a minimum travel time of 0.8 and maximum travel time of 2.0.

abilities.name: Boomstick
abilities.desc: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Wild Axes
abilities.desc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.

notes.note0: This ability destroys trees.

abilities.name: Summon Razorback
abilities.desc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.

abilities.name: Summon Raptors
abilities.desc: Beastmaster summons 2 hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
abilities.shard: Increases Hawk duration by bonus_durations and summons an additional Hawk.

abilities.name: Inner Beast
abilities.desc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.

notes.note0: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.

abilities.name: Drums of Slom
abilities.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.

abilities.name: Primal Roar
abilities.desc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain 40% movement speed for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Plasma Field
abilities.desc: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.

abilities.name: Static Link
abilities.desc: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.

notes.note0: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes 250 units greater than Static Link's cast range.

abilities.name: Storm Surge
abilities.desc: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.

notes.note0: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.shard: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is 0x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by 0s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.

abilities.name: Eye of the Storm
abilities.desc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.

notes.note0: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
notes.note1: Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
notes.note2: Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.

abilities.scepter: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.

abilities.name: Stroke of Fate
abilities.desc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.

abilities.name: Phantom's Embrace
abilities.desc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.

notes.note0: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
notes.note1: The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.

abilities.name: Ink Swell
abilities.desc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After 3 seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
abilities.shard:
Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal % more damage and heal the target for % of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Soulbind
abilities.desc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.

notes.note0: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
notes.note1: Provides vision of both leashed units.

abilities.name: Ink Trail
abilities.desc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for 4.0s.

notes.note0: Provides vision over affected heroes.
notes.note1: Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.

abilities.name: Penitence
abilities.desc: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.

abilities.name: Holy Persuasion
abilities.desc: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3.0 seconds to unsummon it.

notes.note0: Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
notes.note1: Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
notes.note2: The health of creeps already under Chen's control does not update to the new level upon leveling Holy Persuasion further.
notes.note3: Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.

abilities.shard: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.

abilities.name: Divine Favor
abilities.desc:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.

abilities.name: Hand of God
abilities.desc: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for 10 seconds afterwards.

notes.note0: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.

abilities.name: Spirit Lance
abilities.desc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.

notes.note0: Illusions within 675 range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.

abilities.scepter: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.

abilities.name: Doppelganger
abilities.desc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After 1 second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes 500% bonus damage and deals -80% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
notes.note1: Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
notes.note2: Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.

abilities.name: Phantom Rush
abilities.desc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.

notes.note0: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
notes.note1: Rush movement speed is 800.

abilities.name: Illusory Armaments
abilities.desc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Juxtapose
abilities.desc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
abilities.shard: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to  seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by % during this invisibility.

abilities.name: Chaos Bolt
abilities.desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.

notes.note0: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
notes.note1: Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.

abilities.shard: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals 0% less damage.

abilities.name: Reality Rift
abilities.desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.

notes.note0: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.

abilities.shard: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.

abilities.name: Chaos Strike
abilities.desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.

abilities.name: Phantasm
abilities.desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 60/80/100% damage, but take 350% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
notes.note1: Chaos Knight is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.

abilities.scepter:
Gains a passive component.  When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a 0% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.

abilities.name: Time Walk
abilities.desc: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last 2.0 seconds.

notes.note0: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.

abilities.scepter: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.

abilities.name: Time Dilation
abilities.desc: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.

notes.note0: Does not affect item cooldowns.
notes.note1: Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.

abilities.name: Time Lock
abilities.desc: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.

notes.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

abilities.name: Reverse Time Walk
abilities.desc: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.

abilities.name: Distortion Field
abilities.desc: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a 1200 radius of him get slowed by 40%, when they get  within 500 distance of their target.

abilities.name: Chronosphere
abilities.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.

notes.note0: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
notes.note1: Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.

abilities.name: Illusory Orb
abilities.desc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional 3% of its impact damage every 0.5s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

 Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.

notes.note0: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
notes.note1: Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

abilities.name: Waning Rift
abilities.desc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.

abilities.name: Phase Shift
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.

notes.note0: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
notes.note1: Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
notes.note2: Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.

abilities.shard: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.

abilities.name: Puckish
abilities.desc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores 3% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores 3x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

abilities.name: Dream Coil
abilities.desc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.

abilities.name: Blade Fury
abilities.desc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.

notes.note0: You can use items during Blade Fury.
notes.note1: Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.

abilities.scepter:
Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect.

 Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every 0s.

abilities.name: Healing Ward
abilities.desc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts 18/20/22/24 seconds.

notes.note0: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
notes.note1: Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.

abilities.name: Blade Dance
abilities.desc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

abilities.name: Swiftslash
abilities.desc: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.

abilities.name: Bladeform
abilities.desc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2.0s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

notes.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note1: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Omnislash
abilities.desc:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: You can use items during Omnislash.

abilities.name: Charge of Darkness
abilities.desc:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at 25% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after 1.5s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.

notes.note0: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
notes.note1: The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
notes.note2: Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.

abilities.shard: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by bonus_movement_speed.

abilities.name: Bulldoze
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.

abilities.name: Greater Bash
abilities.desc: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.

notes.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
notes.note1: Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.

abilities.scepter: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive 0% damage), and the original target takes 0% of Greater Bash's damage again.

abilities.name: Planar Pocket
abilities.desc: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.

notes.note0: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves 900 units away from the target.

abilities.name: Empowering Haste
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.

notes.note0: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.

abilities.name: Nether Strike
abilities.desc: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.

notes.note0: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.

abilities.scepter: Greatly increases knockback.

abilities.name: Dragon Slave
abilities.desc: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.

notes.note0: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
notes.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: Light Strike Array
abilities.desc: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.

notes.note0: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.

abilities.name: Fiery Soul
abilities.desc: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 16 seconds.

notes.note0: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
notes.note1: Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.

abilities.name: Flame Cloak
abilities.desc: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

abilities.name: Slow Burn
abilities.desc: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.

abilities.name: Laguna Blade
abilities.desc: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.

notes.note0: Laguna Blade has a 0.25 delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.

abilities.shard: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

abilities.name: Mana Break
abilities.desc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.

notes.note0: Mana Break has 25% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.

notes.note0: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

abilities.name: Counterspell
abilities.desc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.

notes.note0: Break disables the passive magic resistance.

abilities.name: Persecutor
abilities.desc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 60% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 60% mana.

notes.note0: Full effect if caused by illusions.

abilities.name: Mana Void
abilities.desc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.

notes.note0: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
notes.note1: The ricochet will travel 1.5x Dead Shot's cast range.
notes.note2: Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.

abilities.name: Pierce the Veil

notes.note0: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
notes.note1: Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.

abilities.shard:
Muerta gains spell_lifesteal% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.
While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains spell_amp_steal% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.

abilities.name: Malefice
abilities.desc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every 2.0/2.0/2.0/2.0 seconds.
abilities.shard: Increases Malefice stun duration by 0.30s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

abilities.name: Demonic Summoning
abilities.desc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by 3% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.

abilities.name: Midnight Pulse
abilities.desc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing 5/10/15/20 + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.

notes.note0: This ability destroys trees in its area.
notes.note1: Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.desc: Units in a 600 radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
abilities.scepter: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to % of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a  AoE. Pulls at a rate of .

abilities.name: Aether Remnant
abilities.desc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.

abilities.name: Dissimilate
abilities.desc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Resonant Pulse
abilities.desc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
abilities.scepter: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain  charges.

abilities.name: Intrinsic Edge
abilities.desc: Void Spirit gains 15% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and 30% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

abilities.name: Astral Step
abilities.desc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.

notes.note0: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.

abilities.name: Tame the Beasts
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to 1.0 second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.

abilities.name: Escape Act
abilities.desc: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
abilities.scepter: Escape Act has  charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

abilities.name: Impalement Arts
abilities.desc: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.

abilities.name: Souvenir Slot
abilities.desc: Gather souvenirs from kills and assists.

abilities.name: Spotlight
abilities.desc: Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for 0.3 seconds after leaving the light.

abilities.name: Wheel of Wonder
abilities.desc:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by -50%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than 0.5 seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Dark Carnival Barker
abilities.desc:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within 925 units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.desc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
abilities.shard: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

abilities.name: Pit of Malice
abilities.desc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every 3.6 seconds.

abilities.name: Atrophy Aura
abilities.desc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.

notes.note0: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.

abilities.name: Invading Force
abilities.desc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

abilities.name: Fiend's Gate
abilities.desc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.

notes.note0: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain

abilities.scepter: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.

abilities.name: Strafe
abilities.desc:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a 1200 radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and 40% of the attack speed bonus. 

 Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.

abilities.name: Searing Arrows
abilities.desc:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for 50% damage.

notes.note0: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
notes.note1: The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.

abilities.name: Death Pact
abilities.desc: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.

notes.note0: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
notes.note1: Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
notes.note2: When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.

abilities.name: Burning Barrage
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.

notes.note0: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.

abilities.name: Burning Army
abilities.desc: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

abilities.name: Skeleton Walk
abilities.desc:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.

notes.note0: Has a fadetime of 0.6/0.6/0.6 seconds.

abilities.name: Infernal Shred
abilities.desc:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to 20% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor).  Clinkz applies 3% per attack, and skeletons apply 1%. 

Lasts 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Crystal Nova
abilities.desc: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.

notes.note0: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.desc: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.

notes.note0: Frostbite is considered a root.

abilities.name: Arcane Aura
abilities.desc:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.

abilities.name: Crystal Clone
abilities.desc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

abilities.name: Glacial Guard
abilities.desc: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

abilities.name: Freezing Field
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.

notes.note0: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts 1.0 second).
notes.note1: Explosions occur every 0.1 seconds.

abilities.scepter: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move % slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over -1s.

abilities.name: Stop Freezing Field
abilities.desc: Immediately stops the Freezing Field

abilities.name: Lucent Beam
abilities.desc: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
abilities.shard: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant % of the damage amount.

abilities.name: Lunar Orbit
abilities.desc: Creates 4 glaives that rotate 225 radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.

abilities.name: Moon Glaives
abilities.desc: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.

notes.note0: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.

abilities.name: Lunar Blessing
abilities.desc: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within 1200 range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.desc: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.

notes.note0: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
notes.note1: Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
notes.note2: Will not hit invisible units.
notes.note3: There is a 0.6/0.6/0.6 seconds gap between beams, 0.3 seconds with scepter.

abilities.scepter: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.

abilities.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
abilities.desc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for 5.0 seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.

abilities.name: Quill Spray
abilities.desc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14.0 seconds.

notes.note0: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

abilities.name: Bristleback
abilities.desc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.

notes.note0: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
notes.note1: Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
notes.note2: Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.scepter: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by -40%.

abilities.name: Hairball
abilities.desc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

abilities.name: Warpath
abilities.desc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.

notes.note0: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
notes.note1: Items will not trigger Warpath.
notes.note2: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note3: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Prickly
abilities.desc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.desc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.

abilities.name: Toss
abilities.desc: Grabs the nearest unit in a 300 radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.

notes.note0: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
notes.note1: Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
notes.note2: Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
notes.note3: Flight time is 1.1s.

abilities.name: Tree Grab
abilities.desc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.

notes.note0: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

abilities.name: Tree Volley
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.

abilities.name: Insurmountable
abilities.desc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.

notes.note0: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

abilities.name: Grow
abilities.desc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.

abilities.name: Acid Spray
abilities.desc: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.

abilities.name: Unstable Concoction
abilities.desc: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After 5.0 seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after 5.5 seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.

notes.note0: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw.  Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
notes.note1: A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
notes.note2: You can deny yourself with this skill.
notes.note3: Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
notes.note4: Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.

abilities.name: Corrosive Weaponry
abilities.desc:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply 2 stacks. Unstable Concoction applies 1 stack per second of brew time.

abilities.name: Berserk Potion
abilities.desc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Greevil's Greed
abilities.desc: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next 40 seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
abilities.scepter: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus 15 damage and 3 additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.

abilities.name: Chemical Rage
abilities.desc:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Has a 0.35 second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.

abilities.name: Wraithfire Blast
abilities.desc: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.

abilities.name: Bone Guard
abilities.desc: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.

notes.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note1: Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.

abilities.name: Mortal Strike
abilities.desc: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.

abilities.name: Vampiric Spirit
abilities.desc: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.

notes.note0: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
notes.note1: Does not affect Reincarnate deaths.
notes.note2: Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
notes.note3: Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.

abilities.scepter: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.

abilities.name: Reincarnation
abilities.desc: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a 600 radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.

notes.note0: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
notes.note1: If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
notes.note2: Revives with full HP and Mana.

abilities.name: Enfeeble
abilities.desc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.

abilities.name: Brain Sap
abilities.desc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
abilities.shard: Reduces cooldown by bonus_AbilityCooldown. Causes Brain Sap to become a  AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for %.

abilities.name: Nightmare
abilities.desc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.

notes.note0: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
notes.note1: Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
notes.note2: On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.

abilities.name: Fiend's Grip
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
abilities.scepter: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by bonus_AbilityCooldowns. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take % incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

abilities.name: Ichor of Nyctasha
abilities.desc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

abilities.name: Searing Chains
abilities.desc: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.

notes.note0: Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
notes.note1: Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.

abilities.name: Sleight of Fist
abilities.desc: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.

notes.note0: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
notes.note1: A regular attack is done to each target every 0.25 seconds.
notes.note2: Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
notes.note3: Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.

abilities.name: Flame Guard
abilities.desc: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.

notes.note0: Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
notes.note1: The damage lingers for an additional 0.5 seconds after application.

abilities.name: Activate Fire Remnant
abilities.desc: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.desc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.

notes.note0: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.

abilities.name: Fire Remnant
abilities.desc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at 250% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.

notes.note0: Starts with 3 charges (maximum).

abilities.shard: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.

abilities.name: Death Pulse
abilities.desc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.

notes.note0: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.

abilities.name: Ghost Shroud
abilities.desc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.

abilities.name: Heartstopper Aura
abilities.desc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.

notes.note0: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
notes.note1: Does not affect ancient creeps.

abilities.scepter: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by 0% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

abilities.name: Death Seeker
abilities.desc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.

notes.note0: Does not trigger spell reflect.

abilities.name: Sadist
abilities.desc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for 8 seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.

notes.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note1: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Reaper's Scythe
abilities.desc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.

notes.note0: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

abilities.name: Guardian Sprint
abilities.desc: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has 100% slow resistance for the first 2.5s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.

notes.note0: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.

abilities.name: Slithereen Crush
abilities.desc: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
abilities.shard: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
abilities.scepter: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.

abilities.name: Bash of the Deep
abilities.desc: After 3 attacks, your next attack will bash the target.

notes.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

abilities.name: Seaborn Sentinel
abilities.desc: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
abilities.scepter: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by 75% and puddle/trail duration by 5s.

abilities.name: Corrosive Haze
abilities.desc: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.

abilities.name: Acorn Shot
abilities.desc:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.

notes.note0: The same target can be hit more than once.
notes.note1: Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
notes.note2: The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Bushwhack
abilities.desc: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.

notes.note0: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
notes.note1: Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.

abilities.name: Scurry
abilities.desc: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by 2.

abilities.name: Decoy
abilities.desc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

abilities.name: Hunter's Boomerang
abilities.desc: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.

abilities.name: Sharpshooter
abilities.desc:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after 3.0 seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after 5.0 seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of 350 from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.

abilities.name: End Sharpshooter
abilities.desc: Release the charged up shot, regain ability to move and attack.

abilities.name: Breathe Fire
abilities.desc: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.

notes.note0: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: Dragon Tail
abilities.desc: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.

abilities.name: Wyrm's Wrath
abilities.desc: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.desc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

abilities.name: Dragon Blood
abilities.desc:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  

Regen and armor are increased by 50% during Elder Dragon Form.

abilities.name: Elder Dragon Form
abilities.desc:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. 

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
abilities.scepter: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

abilities.name: Shadowraze
abilities.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

notes.note0: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

abilities.name: Shadowraze
abilities.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a short distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

notes.note0: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

abilities.name: Shadowraze
abilities.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a longer distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

notes.note0: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

abilities.name: Feast of Souls
abilities.desc:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for 8 seconds. For the duration of the effect, every 0.5s he collects souls from 2 enemies in a 600 radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for 8s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

abilities.name: Presence of the Dark Lord
abilities.desc: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.

notes.note0: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.

abilities.name: Requiem of Souls
abilities.desc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for 0.6 seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of 2.15. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. 

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.

notes.note0: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every 1 soul in his possession.
notes.note1: Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.

abilities.scepter: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

abilities.name: Necromastery
abilities.desc: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining 1 bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant 4 souls. On death, he releases 30.0% of them from bondage.

notes.note0: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
notes.note1: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note2: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.scepter: Increases max souls.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.desc: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for 16 seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every 3.0 seconds.

notes.note0: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
notes.note1: Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.

notes.note0: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

abilities.shard: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals  damage in a  AoE and silences the target for  seconds.

abilities.name: Scream Of Pain
abilities.desc:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.

25.0% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.

notes.note0: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
notes.note1: Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
notes.note2: Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
notes.note3: Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Succubus
abilities.desc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is 150 units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is 800 units or further from her.

abilities.name: Sonic Wave
abilities.desc: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.

notes.note0: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.

abilities.name: Nature's Grasp
abilities.desc: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.

abilities.name: Leech Seed
abilities.desc: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits 2 healing pulses to up to 5 nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.

abilities.name: Living Armor
abilities.desc: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.

notes.note0: Instances of damage less than 10 are ignored.

abilities.name: Eyes In The Forest
abilities.desc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 360 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.

notes.note0: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
notes.note1: If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.

abilities.name: Nature's Guise
abilities.desc: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for 2.75 seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.

notes.note0: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
notes.note1: Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
notes.note2: While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.

abilities.name: Overgrowth
abilities.desc: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.

notes.note0: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.

abilities.name: Split Earth
abilities.desc: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.

notes.note0: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
notes.note1: There is a 0.35 second delay before the effect is applied.

abilities.shard: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location  additional times, with a  second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by . Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.

abilities.name: Diabolic Edict
abilities.desc: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.

notes.note0: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.

abilities.name: Lightning Storm
abilities.desc: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.

abilities.name: Nihilism
abilities.desc: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.

abilities.name: Pulse Nova
abilities.desc: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.

abilities.name: Stifling Dagger
abilities.desc: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing 65/70/75/80+30/45/60/75% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.

notes.note0: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
notes.note1: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
notes.note2: Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.

abilities.name: Phantom Strike
abilities.desc: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.

abilities.name: Blur
abilities.desc: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.

notes.note0: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.

abilities.shard: Decreases Cooldown by bonus_AbilityCooldowns. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance % of their max cooldown values.

abilities.name: Fan of Knives
abilities.desc: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

abilities.name: Immaterial
abilities.desc:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

abilities.name: Coup de Grace
abilities.desc: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.

abilities.name: Starbreaker
abilities.desc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.

notes.note0: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of 215 for the duration of the ability and takes a brief 0.2s to recover after the final strike.
notes.note1: Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
notes.note2: Cleave does not work with this ability.
notes.note3: Can be self-cast to move forward.
notes.note4: The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by -100% for 0.12s.

abilities.shard: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with % magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by 0% down to a minimum of 215.

abilities.name: Celestial Hammer
abilities.desc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.

notes.note0: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
notes.note1: Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
notes.note2: Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.

notes.note0: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
notes.note1: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

abilities.name: Break of Dawn
abilities.desc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
abilities.scepter: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

abilities.name: Solar Guardian
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within 350 units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for 6s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.

notes.note0: Pulse interval is 0.5s.
notes.note1: Total flight duration is 1.7 seconds of channel time + 0.8 of flight time.
notes.note2: Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.

abilities.scepter: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for s after landing.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.desc:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Naga Siren is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
notes.note1: Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
notes.note2: Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

abilities.name: Ensnare
abilities.desc: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
abilities.scepter: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

abilities.name: Rip Tide
abilities.desc: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for 4.0 seconds every 6 attacks.

notes.note0: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.

abilities.name: Reel In
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Naga Siren channels for up to 5 seconds, pulling all units affected by Naga's Ensnare in a 1600 range towards her at a speed of 200. Channeling ends when the Ensnared unit is 100 distance away.
abilities.scepter: Allows Reel In to affect Spell Immune units.

abilities.name: Eelskin
abilities.desc: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within 900 radius.

abilities.name: Song of the Siren
abilities.desc: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.

notes.note0: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
notes.note1: The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.

abilities.shard: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.

abilities.name: Song of the Siren End
abilities.desc: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

abilities.name: Tether
abilities.desc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.

notes.note0: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, Io will latch on and pull itself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
notes.note1: The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
notes.note2: Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.

abilities.shard: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for 0% of the damage done.
