abilities.name: Spirits
abilities.desc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.

notes.note0: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.

abilities.scepter: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.desc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

abilities.name: Relocate
abilities.desc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.

notes.note0: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
notes.note1: If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
notes.note2: If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleport along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.
notes.note3: Only heroes, creep heroes, and illusions can be relocated.

abilities.name: Equilibrium
abilities.desc: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

abilities.name: Burrowstrike
abilities.desc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

 Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.

notes.note0: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: Sand Storm
abilities.desc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.

notes.note0: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
notes.note1: Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in 0.7 seconds.

abilities.name: Stinger
abilities.desc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

abilities.name: Caustic Finale
abilities.desc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

abilities.name: Epicenter
abilities.desc: After a cast point of 2.0 seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.

notes.note0: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.

abilities.shard: Every 3.0s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
abilities.scepter: When the pulses start,  Stinger attack areas are created every s at random locations, each measuring % of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply % of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause  attack(s).

abilities.name: Grave Chill
abilities.desc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.

notes.note0: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
notes.note1: The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
notes.note2: Familiars within 900 range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.

abilities.name: Soul Assumption
abilities.desc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than 100 damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.

notes.note0: Charges are only gained for damage greater than 2.0 and less than 3000.0 that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.

abilities.name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
abilities.desc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within 900 range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.

notes.note0: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
notes.note1: Familiars within 900 range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
notes.note2: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes.note3: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: Stone Form
abilities.desc:
Orders the Familiar closest to Visage to cast Stone Form in its current location, turning into stone and smashing into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area.  The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly.  After 6.0 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

 Can be alt-cast to order the closest Familiar to the target location to move there and cast Stone Form.

notes.note0: While Stone Form is not dispellable, the stun can be removed by strong dispels.

abilities.name: Silent as the Grave
abilities.desc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for 2s.

abilities.name: Summon Familiars
abilities.desc:
Conjures 2 blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.

notes.note0: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
notes.note1: Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.

abilities.name: Stone Form
abilities.desc:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area.  The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly.  After 6.0 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form. 

 Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.

abilities.name: Meat Hook
abilities.desc: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.

notes.note0: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
notes.note1: Meat Hook hits invisible units.
notes.note2: Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
notes.note3: Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
notes.note4: Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.

abilities.shard:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %.

abilities.name: Rot
abilities.desc: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.

notes.note0: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
notes.note1: Rot hits invisible units.
notes.note2: If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
notes.note3: Rot self-damage is non-lethal.

abilities.scepter: Increases Rot radius by bonus_rot_radius, damage by bonus_rot_damage, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %.

abilities.name: Meat Shield
abilities.desc: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.

abilities.name: Flesh Heap
abilities.desc: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 2.0 bonus Strength for each stack.

notes.note0: Enemy Heroes that die within 450 of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.

abilities.name: Dismember
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of 75 units, up to a minimum of 125 range.

notes.note0: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.

abilities.name: Shrapnel
abilities.desc: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every 35 seconds.

notes.note0: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
notes.note1: Does not damage buildings.
notes.note2: Provides vision in the targeted area.

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.desc: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal 20/50/80/110 extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by -100%.

abilities.name: Take Aim
abilities.desc:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by 160/240/320/400.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by 65% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.

abilities.name: Concussive Grenade
abilities.desc: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
abilities.shard: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.

abilities.name: Keen Scope
abilities.desc: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every 100 units of distance Sniper is from the target.

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.desc: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.

notes.note0: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
notes.note1: Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.

abilities.scepter: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.

abilities.name: Battery Assault
abilities.desc: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.

notes.note0: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.

abilities.name: Power Cogs
abilities.desc:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by 50% of the mana burned.

 Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to 850/900/950/1000 distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.

notes.note0: Cogs can shock invisible units.

abilities.name: Rocket Flare
abilities.desc: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for 6.0 seconds.

abilities.name: Overclocking
abilities.desc:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

abilities.name: Jetpack
abilities.desc: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

abilities.name: Hookshot
abilities.desc: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a 175 radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.

notes.note0: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.

abilities.name: Armor Power
abilities.desc:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.25% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.

abilities.name: Poison Attack
abilities.desc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to 6 times.
abilities.shard: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.

abilities.name: Nethertoxin
abilities.desc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.

notes.note0: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.

abilities.name: Corrosive Skin
abilities.desc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a 1200 radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.

notes.note0: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
notes.note1: Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
notes.note2: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Nosedive
abilities.desc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

abilities.name: Viper Strike
abilities.desc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.

abilities.name: Split Shot
abilities.desc:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).

notes.note0: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
notes.note1: If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.

abilities.name: Mystic Snake
abilities.desc: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.

notes.note0: Mystic Snake cannot be disjointed.

abilities.name: Gorgon's Grasp
abilities.desc: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.

abilities.name: Cold Blooded
abilities.desc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.desc: Creates a shield that absorbs 98% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb 60% less damage per point of mana.

notes.note0: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.

abilities.name: Stone Gaze
abilities.desc: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If 2.0 seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.

notes.note0: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.
